description: A .NET 10 framework that generates backend code at compile time for ASP.NET Core and EF Core: entities, DTOs, Minimal API endpoints, validation, state rules and EF Core configuration from declarative Map* calls with chained relationships and traits.
rules: The complete reference is docs/guide.md; read it before declaring or changing a resource.
Every entity is a top-level partial class containing only the application's own fields. Never write Id, Status, TenantId, foreign keys, CreatedAt or other fields a declaration generates.
Declare each entity with exactly one Map* call (MapCrud, MapReadOnly, MapAppendOnly, MapStore, MapSingleton, MapLookup, MapFile, MapBalance, MapJob...). There is no generic MapArchetype entry point.

Chain traits and relationships directly onto the Map* call; the chain is read at compile time, so a trait called later on a variable, in an if or a loop is not seen (HALDUS004). Only MapDetail, MapTransition and MapAction go on the stored builder.
Arguments of declarations must be compile-time constants: enum members, string literals, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15) with constant arguments, lambdas of the form x => x.Property (HALDUS010).
Never hand-write DTOs, endpoints or EF Core configuration for a mapped entity and never edit generated code; change the chain or the partial class and rebuild.
Business logic goes into ITransition<T>, ITransitionHandler<TEntity, TRequest>, IEntityAction<T>, IComputed, IFilter<T> and the job, action and query handlers.
Pages under docs/ other than docs/guide.md are written in Turkish; the API names and code samples in them are the same.
